modifiedBy.description: The user who last modified the instance

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified

instanceIdentifiers.description: List of cloud application instance identifiers

itemValue.description: Tenant profile item value for YouTube category

restrictPersonalO365Domains.description: Flag to restrict personal domains for Office 365

msLoginServicesTrV2.description: Flag to decide between v1 and v2 for tenant restriction on MSLOGINSERVICES

allowGcpCloudStorageRead.description: Flag to allow or disallow cloud storage resources for GCP

order.description: Order of execution of rule with respect to other Web Application rules

timeQuota.description: Daily limit value for time up to which uploading and/or downloading of data is allowed from the Web Application Rule

sizeQuota.description: Daily limit value for size up to which uploading and/or downloading of data is allowed from the Web Application Rule

locations.description: Name-ID pairs of locations for which rule must be applied

groups.description: Name-ID pairs of groups for which rule must be applied

departments.description: Name-ID pairs of departments for which rule will be applied

users.description: Name-ID pairs of users for which rule must be applied

applications.description: List of cloud applications for which rule will be applied

locationGroups.description: Name-ID pairs of locations groups for which rule must be applied.

actions.description: Action taken when traffic matches rule.

timeWindows.description: Name-ID pairs of time interval during which rule must be enforced.

rank.description: Admin rank of the admin who creates this rule

validityStartTime.description: If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the Web Application rule ceases to be valid on this start date and time.

validityEndTime.description: If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the Web Application rule ceases to be valid on this end date and time.

validityTimeZoneId.description: Validity time zone id for start and end time if rule has time based expiry

enforceTimeValidity.description: Enforce a set a validity time period for the Web Application rule

userAgentTypes.description: User Agent types on which this rule will be applied

devices.description: Name-ID pairs of device for which rule will be applied

deviceGroups.description: Name-ID pairs of device groups for which rule will be applied

deviceTrustLevels.description: List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your posture configurations in Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

accessControl.description: Access privilege of this rule based on the admin's RBA state.

cloudAppRiskProfile.description: Name-ID pair of cloud Application Risk Profile for which rule will be applied

userRiskScoreLevels.description: List of user risk score levels for which policy must be applied. If not set, the policy will be applied for all user risk score levels.

id.description: A unique identifier for an entity

name.description: The configured name of the entity

externalId.description: An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

EntityReference.description: This is an immutable reference to an entity that mainly consists of id and name

instanceId.description: ID of the cloud application instance identifier

instanceIdentifier.description: Cloud application instance identifier, such as URL, IP address, or keyword.

instanceIdentifierName.description: Name of  the cloud application instance identifier

identifierType.description: Type of the cloud application instance identifier

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the cloud application instance identifier was last modified

modifiedBy.description: The user who last modified the cloud application instance identifier

webApplicationClass.description: The cloud application class selected from the available options

BrowserIsolationProfile.description: Information about browser isolation profile. To learn more, see What Is Isolation? and Creating Isolation Profiles for ZIA.

id.description: The universally unique identifier (UUID) for the browser isolation profile

defaultProfile.description: (Optional) Indicates whether this is a default browser isolation profile. Zscaler sets this field.

type.description: The instance of the cloud application selected from the available options.
